status: main controlled ablation (confirmatory within the exposed discovery suite). Frozen before launch: arms M0-M4 (one factor per adjacent contrast), trigger 24000/6000 from the first pilot (repeated compactions, no fallback), tasks = the six baseline tasks (fixed before any new-code run) + s1-amended-billing (specified after the first pilot, before any main run; its pilot checked plumbing only), 3 repeats, seeded interleaved queue, safety stops below. No re-runs for outcomes.
routeRationale: Production main model and default thinking (~/.pi/agent/settings.json defaultModel cliproxyapi/gpt-6-astra, defaultThinkingLevel high; orche default extendedContext true). Production orche workers run on cliproxyapi/claude-opus-5-5, which the evaluator's fail-closed sandbox gate cannot verify (only the codex responses endpoint is admitted); every tier is pinned to the one route as in every earlier experiment. Model and effort are identical in every arm; thinkingPolicy stays fixed (no step-down).

arms.intervention: M1 + early worker compaction: absolute 24000/6000 (pilot-fixed), basic essentials

arms.intervention: M3 + orche_spawn sub-worker compaction with own essentials

tasks.split: discovery: six exposed suite tasks + ctx-state-1 own multi-turn task

randomization: ctrl-ablation-1 buildQueue: blocks (task, repeat) shuffled, arm order shuffled inside each block, one queue consumed by `parallelism` workers

analysis.primary: valid success (ctrl-ablation-1 definition: completed, hidden pass, no integrity violation, strict test immutability)
contrasts: M3-M2 (extended essentials package incl. retrieval reference; not a pure retrieval effect)
analysis.inference: paired by (task, repeat); task-cluster bootstrap 95% CI of the difference (resamples tasks, not runs) and exact within-task sign-flip randomization p; Holm over the four contrasts
analysis.viability: a contrast is viable for adoption only if its CI lower bound > 0, Holm p < 0.05, no increase in critical failures; ties or wide CIs are INCONCLUSIVE, never equivalence
analysis.holdout: only for a viable contrast: obtain an unused eligible holdout batch through the existing supply route and run the preregistered confirmation; otherwise not performed
analysis.secondary: descriptive per arm: compactions, early, fallbacks, failures, summary vs task requests, max observed input, transcript reads (successful, with content), s1 turn completion and failing hidden tests (amended rule, batch id), spawned sub-workers
